faq.question: What is LoveGoBuy?
faq.answer: LoveGoBuy is a shopping agent for purchasing goods from China and arranging warehouse handling and international delivery.

faq.question: Which marketplaces does LoveGoBuy's guide mention?
faq.answer: Its purchasing guide names Taobao, Tmall, 1688 and Weidian.

faq.question: How do I start with a product link?
faq.answer: Paste the source product URL into LoveGoBuy's search field, then check the listing and available options.

faq.question: Does the official LoveGoBuy website offer image search?
faq.answer: The official homepage describes photo-based product search. That does not mean every independent spreadsheet website provides the same feature.

faq.question: When should I select the size and color?
faq.answer: Review the product's available options before adding it to the cart or submitting the order.

faq.question: Is paying for an item the same as paying international shipping?
faq.answer: No. The official guide treats item payment and later international parcel payment as separate steps.

faq.question: What is domestic shipping?
faq.answer: It is delivery from the seller to LoveGoBuy's warehouse, included in the official explanation of item cost.

faq.question: Is a catalog price my complete delivered cost?
faq.answer: Do not assume so. The official fee explanation separates the product, domestic delivery and international shipping components.

faq.question: What affects international shipping cost?
faq.answer: LoveGoBuy's fee guide identifies weight, shipping method and destination. Use the current estimator for your parcel.

faq.question: What should I prepare for a shipping estimate?
faq.answer: Prepare your destination, parcel weight, dimensions and goods category. More accurate inputs make the comparison more useful.

faq.question: Why can a light parcel still be expensive?
faq.answer: Parcel dimensions can affect chargeable weight. Check the selected route's own rules instead of assuming every route uses one formula.

faq.question: Why might the estimator show no available route?
faq.answer: Oversize or overweight parcels can lack eligible routes. Recheck your inputs and current route limits before choosing parcel contents.

faq.question: Does LoveGoBuy mention parcel rehearsal?
faq.answer: The estimator recommends rehearsal for more useful parcel weight and volume information. Check availability and terms in your account.

faq.question: When are warehouse photos taken?
faq.answer: The guide places photography and inspection after an item reaches the warehouse.

faq.question: Where does the guide tell me to find warehoused items?
faq.answer: Open User Center, then Warehouse.

faq.question: What does the inspection answer say is checked?
faq.answer: It describes visible color, requested size and significant damage checks, with limits on fine details.

faq.question: Are electronics powered on during inspection?
faq.answer: The help center describes exterior and accessory checks, not functional testing by powering on.

faq.question: Do QC photos prove authenticity or long-term durability?
faq.answer: Do not treat a photograph as that proof. Independent advice: separate visible observations from questions that require other evidence.

faq.question: Should I always choose my usual size?
faq.answer: Independent advice: use that product's measurements and size chart. A familiar size label alone does not establish the fit.

faq.question: Can I combine warehoused purchases?
faq.answer: The guide describes selecting stored items and consolidating them for shipment.

faq.question: How does parcel submission work?
faq.answer: Select warehouse items, enter delivery details and choose a delivery service before paying international shipping.

faq.question: Where can I follow my parcel?
faq.answer: The official guide directs buyers to the Parcels page.

faq.question: How long can I keep goods in the warehouse?
faq.answer: Check the deadline and storage terms shown for your items in your account. We have not verified one universal free-storage duration.

faq.question: Can every item be returned?
faq.answer: No universal return entitlement is established. Eligibility depends on seller agreement, item condition and the applicable order deadline.

faq.question: Are returns always free?
faq.answer: Do not assume that. The help center describes conditional service charges and possible domestic return-shipping costs.

faq.question: Can removing tags or packaging affect returns?
faq.answer: Yes. The return conditions identify removed tags, packaging and accessories as potential eligibility problems.

faq.question: Can I change an order after submitting it?
faq.answer: The help center distinguishes seller dispatch status. Ask support about your exact order before assuming it can be changed.

faq.question: Why might an order show an outstanding balance?
faq.answer: The help center mentions seller-price adjustments, particularly domestic delivery. Check the order's explanation before paying.

faq.question: When should I raise a problem with a warehouse item?
faq.answer: Review it promptly. The published help describes a five-day stock-in return window; confirm your order's current deadline and eligibility.

faq.question: Which payment method should I expect at checkout?
faq.answer: Use the options currently offered in your account and review their displayed terms. We have not verified a universal payment-method list.

faq.question: Does LoveGoBuy mention multiple currencies?
faq.answer: Its homepage advertises multi-currency payments. Check the actual checkout currency and total before confirming.

faq.question: Is a coupon mentioned in a guide guaranteed to work?
faq.answer: No. Independent advice: verify the current promotion's eligibility, minimum spend and expiry directly on LoveGoBuy before budgeting for it.

faq.question: Where can I contact official support?
faq.answer: The official contact page lists support@lovegobuy.com and additional support channels. Include the relevant order reference when asking for help.

faq.question: What should I check if a product link opens incorrectly?
faq.answer: Independent advice: compare the original URL, marketplace and product ID. Then try the complete source link in LoveGoBuy's search field.

faq.question: Can I rely on a universal delivery time quoted by a spreadsheet?
faq.answer: No universal delivery promise was verified. Independent advice: check the current route information for your destination and parcel.

faq.question: Are another buyer's QC photos the same as photos of my order?
faq.answer: No. Independent advice: use your own warehouse order photos for the item you will receive; public images provide context only.
